main.description: A file or folder in a drive. The record key is its permanent ID: renames and moves update the record, never the key. All but the chunks' blob refs is sealed. The sealed payload is {name, parent?, kind ('file' or 'folder'), size?, sha256?, chunkIDs?, createdAt, modifiedAt?, version?, contentsFrom?}: parent is the folder's record key; sha256 is of the whole file, in hex; chunkIDs decrypt the chunks, in the same order; version is the record key of the node's current version; contentsFrom, of the version that holds these chunks.

chunks.description: Files only: the contents, in encrypted chunks, in order. Readable so the PDS keeps the blobs while the record references them.

sealed.description: Everything else, sealed for this collection and record key.
